name: absolutpowers
description: AI-assisted development lifecycle skills for planning, implementation, review, debugging, human onboarding reports, and shared project context. Works with Grok Build (first-class), Claude Code, Codex, and Pi.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, implement, review, debug, explain, and maintain shared AI context
interface.longDescription: A shared development workflow plugin. Covers feature discussion, task generation, implementation, review, debugging, human-readable onboarding reports, and synchronized CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md project context. First-class support for Grok Build, Claude Code, Codex, and Pi via a single host-agnostic skill tree.
defaultPrompt: Use absolutpowers skills (feature-discuss, generate-tasks, implement, review, ship, debug, etc.) to discuss, plan, implement, review, explain, and keep project context in sync.
